verdict.rationale: The evidence only glancingly touches portfolio reporting. Developers can build custom dashboard widgets and full-page apps, the AI features claim to spot progress gaps and automate status and performance reports, and the integrations page claims a real-time cross-platform view. None of these explicitly describes rolling up progress across multiple projects into a single portfolio view. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of a native multi-project/portfolio dashboard, cross-board progress aggregation details, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
